Text: Full time. The whole side ends up back at the Stammtisch.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. Played after the tutorial match (Tuning.csv tutorial_morning_scene), then the base.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Not bad, Trainer! Not bad at all for a first match.

Speaker: Koch
Text: *hic* ...Did we win?

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: You were there, Koch!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Before I leave for Beuterdorf, there are two more things you need to know. Where the players sleep, and where the beer comes from.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Come on. Everybody out to the Dorms.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: This is our town. Most of it stays locked until you buy the keys at the Club House.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. Guide.csv tut_morning_base.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: But the Dorms are open. Every tired player sleeps there. Let us have a look.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: A player's power is two numbers in one. How many rounds they play before they need a bed, and how many fixtures they sleep.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. Guide.csv tut_morning_beds, over the Dorms.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: A Power 3 plays three rounds, then sleeps three fixtures. Our Power 1s are done after one match already.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: A Power 0 plays one round and needs no bed at all. Weak, but always ready.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: A fixture is a match or an Adventure. Every one you play brings everybody in bed a step nearer to waking up.

Speaker: Koch
Text: And the beer wears off. Such a shame.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Half of what is in them is gone after every round they play. And nobody wakes up in here drunk.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: So you cannot field your best side every week. While one side rests, the other one works.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Now, the Brewery. Somebody drank it dry.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. Guide.csv tut_morning_handover. The Head Coach leaves here; Koch guides the rest.

Speaker: Koch
Text: It was a long match...

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: The Brewer needs reed for the next batch, and reed grows in the Marshlands. Creatures and all.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: That is a job for the Adventure Team. They train for runs, not for the pitch. Four of them, one for each Tier.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: And this is where I leave you, Trainer. Beuterdorf needs me. Koch knows the way to the marsh.

Speaker: Koch
Text: I do?

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: You do. Servus, Trainer. Look after my town.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Right then! Adventure! Up at the top, the banner with the mountain.

Speaker: Koch
Text: The Bounty Board. Pick where we go, then which job. Every job ends with a boss.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. Guide.csv tut_morning_board.

Speaker: Koch
Text: The Marshlands, then the Brewer's Errand. One stretch of marsh and the Reed Warden at the end.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Off we go! The four of them run and the ball goes with them.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. MatchTalk.csv tut_adv_start.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Remember: nothing we pick up is ours until we carry it home.

Speaker: Koch
Text: There, something lying about! Whoever is closest peels off and grabs it.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Hold up. Something is in the way. That means a fight.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: First we pick who we go after. Point at one of them and click. Hover first and it tells you everything about it.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Now one player from each Tier, Tier I first. They pass the ball up the line and the last one shoots.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Every pick tires them a little. Stamina only counts out here, not on the pitch.

Speaker: Koch
Text: See the icons along the top? That is the pile. Point at a card and it shows which icons it adds.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Collect enough of one kind and it pays out on top of the hit.

Speaker: Koch
Text: All four powers and the pile go into the one we picked. Then everything still standing hits back.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Down! Out of stamina means out for the rest of the run, and one more fixture in bed back home.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: If a whole Tier has nobody left, they walk straight through it and hit twice as hard. Keep all four standing.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Cleared! Now the big question: further in, or home?
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. The wave before the boss.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Further in there is more to carry. But if everybody falls we lose all of it. Flee and we keep most of it.

Speaker: Koch
Text: The Warden is just ahead. Let us push on!

Speaker: Koch
Text: That is the Reed Warden. The bark on him only gives a little each hit, so hit hard.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: The Warden is down! Claim the bounty and we carry the lot home.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Home! The Brewer will be pleased. Let us see who needs a bed now.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. Guide.csv tut_morning_home, however the run ended.

Speaker: Koch
Text: See? The Adventure was a fixture too. The match side is a step nearer to waking up.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, "the morning after") - rewrite them here. Guide.csv tut_morning_beds_2. Its Then is tutorial:end.

Speaker: Koch
Text: And whoever played their last round out there is in bed now. Knocked over on the run? One fixture more.

Speaker: Koch
Text: That is the whole trick, Trainer. Match Team one week, Adventure Team the next, and nobody sleeps through a match day.

Speaker: Koch
Text: The town is yours now. The Head Coach left you a starting side. Prost!
